## Cover letter
We propose one-time standard home cleaning for Sample customer at Example property. Please review the scope and service agreement below.

## Scope of service
Service schedule: One-time service.
```veliz_scope_table
{"rows":[{"area":"Dust reachable surfaces","frequency":"One-time service","notes":""},{"area":"Vacuum and mop accessible floors","frequency":"One-time service","notes":""},{"area":"Clean kitchen counters, sink and appliance exteriors","frequency":"One-time service","notes":""},{"area":"Clean bathrooms, fixtures and mirrors","frequency":"One-time service","notes":""},{"area":"Empty ordinary household trash","frequency":"One-time service","notes":""}]}
```

Property: house; 1500 cleanable square feet, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms; occupied.



Ordinary cleaning supplies are included.

### Exclusions
- Regulated, biohazard and mold remediation
- Construction debris and pest remediation
- Exterior or high-access work
- Heavy furniture moving
- Appliance interiors unless selected

### Optional services
- Appliance interiors (count each appliance); agree scope and price before adding work.
- Additional labor after walkthrough review; agree scope and price before adding work.

### Customer responsibilities
- Provide safe access, running water and electricity
- Secure pets and valuables
- Identify delicate surfaces and existing damage
- Approve scope or price changes before work
